<thought>We need a template that describes a nucleophilic aromatic substitution where a halide is replaced by an amine, forming a C‑N bond and breaking a C‑X (halide) bond. Using the template search tool with the forward‑reaction criteria “halide” broken and “amine” formed should retrieve suitable templates. Once we have a template ID, we can fetch its SMARTS and map the reaction to obtain the mapped_rxn string.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
